thread:
olivia: Heads-up: prepping 1.4.3-private canary packaging for EMEA private/VPC customers. Packaging job starts 09:00 UTC tomorrow, canary deploy window 10:30–11:30 UTC.
chris: thanks — which images are we pinning?
omaya: tagging strategy: pin installer to `v1.4.3-private-rc1`, images to `sha256:` pins in the submanifest.
samir: rollback criteria we agreed last week still ok? high error rate >3% 5m, or KV cache corruption alerts.
olivia: yes, same SLO thresholds. If canary crosses error threshold, immediate pin-back to 1.4.2-private and abort fanout.
chris: packaging checklist: build artifacts, cosign, checksum, manifest, signer handoff. Who's owner for cosign?
maya: i'm owner for cosign signing. I'll rotate ephemeral key and hand off to delivery ops. ops-bot: please add signer entry to the delivery runbook.
ops-bot: added signer: maya@redwood (ephemeral cosign key) to runbook. ETA 08:45 UTC. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: [info] build triggered: `make airgap-bundle VERSION=v1.4.3-private-rc1`
deploy-bot: [info] artifact: private-installer-v1.4.3-rc1.tar.gz created (size 1.2GB)
deploy-bot: [info] cosign sign step queued
maya: cosign signing done. signature: cosign:sha256:abc123... Signed and uploaded to signer-store.
olivia: checksum step: running sha256sum on bundle then updating submanifest.
chris: submanifest excerpt (for ops):
```
- installer: private-installer-v1.4.3-rc1.tar.gz
  digest: sha256:111aaa222bbb333ccc
  cosign: cosign:sha256:abc123...
- runtime-image: registry.redwood/internal/runtime@sha256:444ddd555eee
```
maya: cosign TTL set to 8h for canary. We'll publish a shorter TTL so we can rotate quickly if needed.
samir: canary rollout plan: 10:30 UTC EMEA seed (5 hosts), monitor 30m, if OK expand to 20 hosts at 11:00 UTC, then full fanout 11:15 UTC. If any step fails, abort and pin back.
olivia: explicit abort command (ops runbook):
```
# abort canary and pin back
deploybot abort --thread 1765559999 --reason "canary fail"
deploybot pin --manifest submanifest-1.4.2.json --force
```
chris: quick preflight commands to run before packaging:
```
# verify manifest hashes
sha256sum private-installer-v1.4.3-rc1.tar.gz > private-installer-v1.4.3-rc1.sha256
cat private-installer-v1.4.3-rc1.sha256 | grep -q "111aaa" || echo "HASH MISMATCH" && exit 1
```
ops-bot: scheduling note: delivery ops will hold a 15-min preflight standup at 08:50 UTC in #release-ops.
maya: reminder: offline mirrors need the signed submanifest copy. I'll scp the signed manifest to mirror staging after signing.
olivia: communication plan: post release-notes draft to #product-release at 09:15 UTC, cc sales and customer-success for EMEA private accounts.
samir: monitoring hooks: enable KV-cache guards and rate-limit dashboards for canary hosts. If 429 spikes >2% sustained for 10m treat as failure.
chris: any DB migrations in this bundle?
olivia: none. only packaging and image pins.
maya: last bit — cosign key expiry at 17:00 UTC, rotate key and push new signature if we haven't finished by then. I'll call it out in runbook.
deploy-bot: [scheduled] canary rollout: 2026-01-12T10:30:00Z thread=1765559999 initiator=olivia
olivia: ok all, i'll kick packaging tomorrow 09:00 UTC and ping this thread when artifacts land. thanks everyone :rocket:
